title: Fragment: Last Covenant Watch
obscured_text: Salt has eaten most of the script. Three names remain, written over each other until they look like one pulse.
The fragment does not accuse. It keeps vigil.
revealed_text: A covenant watch is the promise that no Harbinger studies dangerous blood alone. The wreck broke that promise by force, not by choice.
The last hand to touch this mark wrote: if we do not surface, let our notes be useful and our bodies be forgiven.
